description: This Java source file defines the PropsHelper class, which provides utility methods for getting, setting, and deleting CPE properties, including conversions to int and boolean types, with external dependencies on PropsServiceClient, CpePropertyEvent, IPCException, StringUtils, and logging via SLF4J.

classes.name: PropsHelper
classes.description: Helper class to simplify getting and setting CPE properties, with conversion utilities.

methods.name: getCpeProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a CPE property value by key, returns default if not found or error occurs.

methods.name: getCpeIntProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a CPE property as an integer, with default fallback.

methods.name: getCpeIntProperty (overload)
methods.description: Retrieves a CPE property from a CpePropertyEvent as an integer.

methods.name: getCpeBoolProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a CPE property as a boolean, with default fallback.

methods.name: getCpeBoolProperty (overload)
methods.description: Retrieves a CPE property from a CpePropertyEvent as a boolean.

methods.name: setCpeProperty
methods.description: Sets a CPE property with a string value.

methods.name: setCpeProperty (boolean)
methods.description: Sets a CPE property with a boolean value.

methods.name: setCpeProperty (int)
methods.description: Sets a CPE property with an integer value.

methods.name: setCpeProperty (long)
methods.description: Sets a CPE property with a long value.

methods.name: setCpeProperty (double)
methods.description: Sets a CPE property with a double value.

methods.name: setCpeProperty (float)
methods.description: Sets a CPE property with a float value.

methods.name: delCpeProperty
methods.description: Deletes a CPE property by key.
